name: binance.deposit
description: Deposit native ETH or an exact ERC20 token from a protected EVM wallet into a Binance main account or subaccount using its own credentials. Live Binance metadata selects the asset/network route; completion requires canonical chain evidence and matching usable Binance credit.
coverage: Synthetic broker-composite transport and canonical fake-EVM proof; live funding capabilities and acceptance remain separately reported.
completion: Original transaction identity is canonical and finalized, and exactly one usable matching Binance credit plus the corresponding free-balance increase is observed.

semantics.accounts: Main or subaccount using its own credential; no master required. Parent-authorized hierarchy reads remain optional.
semantics.amount: exact finite amount; amount=all is unsupported
semantics.approval: Fresh Touch ID binds source wallet, destination account, chain, asset, deposit address, amount, gas envelope and displayed USD ceilings. Fresh quote evidence may vary within those ceilings.
semantics.coin: Binance asset identity; never resolved from an EVM ticker
semantics.completion: chain submission alone is insufficient; matching usable deposit history and balance delta are required
semantics.legacyDefaults: Omitted coin/network select ETH on Ethereum mainnet; omitted chainId resolves the reviewed Binance network mapping. ERC20 token contract must be explicit.
semantics.maxFeeEth: Maximum total chain-native fee in ETH. The wallet transfer reserves 20% gas-unit and up to 50% fee-quote headroom, including priority fees, within this cap before approval; routine gas changes within the frozen envelope are accepted.
semantics.network: explicit Binance network code matched to current metadata and a configured Fin EVM chain
semantics.recipient: fixed from the authenticated account's current Binance deposit-address endpoint
semantics.recovery: Reconcile the original operation after response loss, delayed credit or restart; do not resend under a new request ID.
semantics.sourceCoverage: Configured Fin EVM chains with an explicit reviewed Binance network mapping; other source chains, memo/tag routes and non-unit denominations are unavailable.
semantics.token: native or exact ERC20 contract; contract and decimals are checked against both Binance and chain metadata

name: binance.deposit-address

coverage: Own-account Binance USER_DATA read uses the selected connection's credential, including a subaccount-only connection; no parent/master lookup is made. A Binance denial applies to this endpoint/capability and should be reported specifically. Synthetic tests; live account eligibility remains account-dependent.
completion: Address observed; credit requires a matching Binance deposit record.

semantics.amount: exact decimal string

completion: Bounded address-book observation only; no address creation, whitelist modification, account-wide enforcement or withdrawal eligibility proof.

semantics.human_action: Use Binance Deposit Crypto to claim a new address where available, then repeat this read.
semantics.limits: Per-entry whitelist flags do not prove account-wide enforcement or that a security cooldown has elapsed.
